note: Item registry. kind: key (can't be sold, stacked or used up) or consumable (stack cap 99). heal_hp / heal_mp are effects; price_dp is the spirit-stall price in Dewdrops. Chapter 1 values from docs/chapter-01/data.

item_railway_token.name: Old Railway Token
item_railway_token.text: Reno's lucky token. Nenek says he had it when she found him.

item_dewdrop_candy.name: Dewdrop Candy
item_dewdrop_candy.text: A sweet spirit candy. Restores 10 HP and 4 MP.

item_gate_key.name: Gate Key
item_gate_key.text: An old key from the Whispering Roots.

item_guardian_seed.name: Guardian Seed
item_guardian_seed.text: A seed left by the Thornkeeper.

item_bobo_parcel.name: Bobo's Parcel
item_bobo_parcel.text: Slightly nibbled. Missing half a biscuit.

item_kaya_toast.name: Kaya Toast
item_kaya_toast.text: It fell off a plate. Restores 20 HP.

item_moonleaf_bun.name: Moonleaf Bun
item_moonleaf_bun.text: A soft spirit bun. Restores 20 HP.

item_postcard.name: Postcard Home
item_postcard.text: A fisherman dropped it on the jetty. It needs posting in Bandar Senja.

item_parcel_a.name: Parcel A
item_parcel_a.text: The stationmaster's parcel, from the goods shed.

item_parcel_b.name: Parcel B
item_parcel_b.text: The stationmaster's parcel, chewed at one corner by moths.

item_parcel_c.name: Parcel C
item_parcel_c.text: The stationmaster's parcel, back from the bicycle shop.

item_veil_ticket.name: Veil-Stamped Tickets x2
item_veil_ticket.text: Two tickets with a violet tick mark. They keep your destination safe in the Veil.

item_blank_punched_ticket.name: Blank Punched Ticket
item_blank_punched_ticket.text: A ticket with no destination, just a neat hole.

item_label_fragments.name: Label Fragments
item_label_fragments.text: What Lumi saw in the smudged label: something BLUE, a ROUND shape, and the letters '...CLE'.

equip_moth_wing_charm.name: Moth-Wing Charm
equip_moth_wing_charm.text: A papery charm. Lumi wears it: SPD +2.

item_slip_chalk.name: Glowing Slip (chalk)
item_slip_chalk.text: A faint slip of light. It smells of chalk dust.

item_slip_laugh.name: Glowing Slip (laughter)
item_slip_laugh.text: A faint slip of light. It hums with a baby's laugh.

item_slip_cloth.name: Glowing Slip (cloth)
item_slip_cloth.text: A faint slip of light. It feels like soft new cloth.

item_conductors_whistle.name: Conductor's Whistle
item_conductors_whistle.text: A brass whistle from the Veil Halt. The river might answer it.

equip_brass_lantern_hook.name: Brass Lantern Hook
equip_brass_lantern_hook.text: A hook for the lantern. Lumi carries it: MAG +3.

item_river_rice_cake.name: River Rice Cake
item_river_rice_cake.text: Wrapped in a leaf that smells of the river. Restores 45 HP.

item_tide_verse_1.name: Tide Song, Verse 1
item_tide_verse_1.text: From Pak Lumpur: "Low water, show the way."

item_tide_verse_2.name: Tide Song, Verse 2
item_tide_verse_2.text: From Old Pole: "Many voices, one river."

item_tide_verse_3.name: Tide Song, Verse 3
item_tide_verse_3.text: From the Barnacle Bell: "Every tide comes back."

item_tide_pearl.name: Tide Pearl
item_tide_pearl.text: Nenek Arus's pearl. Hold it to your ear and it hums the Tide Song.

equip_bell_clapper.name: Soggy Bell Clapper
equip_bell_clapper.text: Heavy and damp. Reno wears it: DEF +3.

item_lost_toy_boat.name: Toy Boat
item_lost_toy_boat.text: A little wooden boat with a paper sail. The river kept it.

item_lost_bell.name: Bicycle Bell
item_lost_bell.text: Rusty, but it still rings. The river kept it.

item_lost_ring.name: Wedding Ring
item_lost_ring.text: Thin and gold, found in the jetty mud. The river kept it.
